messages:
teri_ae: Quick alert POC for SkyBridge in ap-southeast-1 showing median TTFT ~900ms on short prompts; expected ~180-300ms. Also intermittent 429s during short evening bursts. Demo tomorrow morning APAC. Need fast triage. cc @sam_se @yasmin_ml

sam_se: Are they on Hosted? model name? concurrency? any warmup used?

teri_ae: Hosted, model: rwd-13b-compat, concurrency ~40, avg prompt 30 tokens, context ~200 tokens. No warmup. Logs: https://paste.example.com/skybridge (sanitized)

yasmin_ml: Two likely issues: (1) cache miss due to distinct convo keys per session, (2) batching head-of-line when mixed short/long contexts.

yasmin_ml: Proposed quick test: enable prefix_kv for account and run a 5x prefix warmup with a shared convo_key. Measure p50/p95.

zhou_sre: Noted. There was a brief shard rebalancing in ap-southeast at 01:40 local that caused queueing for ~4 minutes. For 429s, looks gateway-level. I'll temporarily raise soft quota for POC. quota_bot: "applied soft quota bump to account skybridge: 1800 r/min until 2026-04-02T04:00:00Z"

sam_se: Also share X-Redwood-Route from a 429 so we can confirm layer.

teri_ae: 429 example: response {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":12}, header X-Redwood-Route: ap-southeast-1-hst-04

zhou_sre: Gateway throttle. I'll enable prefix_kv and set max_batch_size=3 for their route to reduce queueing.

yasmin_ml: Good. After that, test with a synthetic workload of 40 clients, 50 req each, short prompts. Compare avg_batch_size and queue_wait_ms pre/post.

sam_se: Warmup snippet I'll run for them: for i in 1..6; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-compat","prompt":"warmup","convo_key":"skybridge-warm"}'; sleep 0.1; done

teri_ae: Ran tests after config change at 22:10 local: p50 ~260ms, p95 ~510ms. 429s reduced but still appear when frontend bursts uncontrolled >1.5k r/min.

yasmin_ml: That p95 improvement tracks with reduced batch queueing. Remaining 429s need smoothing at client or a higher temporary quota.

pat_sec: SkyBridge asks about CMK and 90-day log retention. Can we enable for hosted POC?

zhou_sre: Yes we can enable CMK for POC after brief review and infra ticket; 90-day retention OK. I'll open the infra change and link Jira.

ana_devex: I'll prepare a short POC playbook (warmup script, client smoothing example, batch tuning guidance, cost impact). Also will include quick pricing delta Hosted vs Dedicated for a 30m spike.

sam_se: For 429s, next options: (A) ask for a demo-time soft quota increase (we can do short window), (B) recommend Dedicated for demo traffic. I'll raise support ticket now.

quota_bot: support-bot: "SUP-9012: requested soft quota bump for skybridge during demo window"

teri_ae: Summary/todo: 1) Zhou: CMK infra ticket + temporary quota (SUP-9012) 2) Yasmin/Sam: finalize warmup & batch config runbook, post metrics 3) Ana: pricing + playbook 4) Pat: security questionnaire draft. Demo at 09:00 SGT tomorrow. Thanks team :thumbsup:

ana_devex: I'll upload runbook and sample curl snippets in the docs channel in 1 hour.

sam_se: I'll attach pre/post batch metrics shortly.
